description_en: Use this operation to create an agent group
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以进行新增外呼组操作
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-create-agent-group --enterprise-id 7000002 --gno WH12 --group-name gpname1 --comment comment3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudCreateAgentGroup

parameters.description_en: The ID of the call center.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.description_en: The outbound group number, which must be unique within an enterprise. The number must be 2 to 20 characters long, start with a letter, and contain only letters and digits. An enterprise can have a maximum of 1,000 agent groups.
parameters.description_zh: 说明：同一企业外呼组编号不能重复，外呼组编号长度为2-20，以字母开头，须同时且只能包含字母和数字，同一企业最多可创建1000个外呼组。

parameters.name: gno

parameters.description_en: The outbound group name. The name cannot be empty, must not exceed 50 characters, and must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.
